name: Lizard cake
summary: A cake made from dông, the lizard caught on Phú Yên’s beach sand in summer. It is eaten with fresh herbs.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang is the account of chả dông.
howToEat: Eat it with fresh herbs, in summer when the dông are caught.
seoTitle: Cha dong in Phu Yen — summer lizard cake
seoDescription: Cake made from dong lizards caught on the beach sand in summer, eaten with fresh herbs on Nguyen Cong Tru.
